g.text: Our virtual care program connects members with board-certified providers for everyday
health needs. Members can start a visit from a phone or computer, share symptoms and
history in advance, and get a care plan that is saved to their health record. Follow-up
messages are handled through the same secure channel, so questions between visits do
not need a new appointment. Prescriptions are sent to the pharmacy the member chooses,
and lab orders are routed to a nearby location when tests are needed.
